mapper.select: /* apiDefReg.selSysApiTree */ SELECT s.api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,s.api_nm AS "spcNm" ,s.ver AS "ver" ,c.ctgry_nm AS "ctgryNm" ,d.api_nm AS "apiNm" ,d.api_path AS "apiPath" ,d.method_cd AS "methodCd" FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF d ON d.API_SPC_NO = s.API_SPC_NO LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_CTGRY c ON c.API_CTGRY_NO = d.API_CTGRY_NO WHERE s.SYS_ID = #{sysId} AND s.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY s.API_SPC_NO, c.SORT_ODRG, d.SORT_ODRG

/* apiDefReg.selSpcByNo */ SELECT s.api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,s.api_nm AS "spcNm" ,s.sys_id AS "sysId" ,s.host AS "host" ,s.bas_path AS "basPath" ,s.ver AS "ver" FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s WHERE s.DEL_YN = 'N' AND s.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer
/* apiDefReg.selDefaultCtgryBySpc */ SELECT API_CTGRY_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY WHERE API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY API_CTGRY_NO LIMIT 1
